newsitem.title: USA: Coleman Co names Steven Kaplan CFO.
newsitem.headline: Coleman Co names Steven Kaplan CFO.

text.p: The Coleman Company said Monday that Steven Kaplan had been appointed executive vice president and chief financial officer.
The company said Kaplan replaced George Mileusnic, who transfered to a new position, executive vice president of administration for Coleman's largest business unit, North American Recreation.
Prior to joining Coleman, Kaplan's business associations included The Boston Consulting Group where he was a vice president and partner, a statement from Coleman said.
In addition, the statement said, he was chief financial officer of Marcam Corporation, executive vice president and chief financial officer of AM International Inc .
Mileusnic will be responsible for finance, management information services, physical distribution/customer service and human resources for North American Recreation and Coleman Spas.
